---
title: "Command-line interface: ragframework ingest / ragframework query"
labels: ["enhancement", "help wanted"]
---

## Description

Add a small CLI (stdlib `argparse`, no new required deps) exposed as a console script:

```bash
ragframework ingest ./docs --index ./index --embedder huggingface --retriever faiss
ragframework query "How do I configure chunk overlap?" --index ./index --top-k 3
ragframework --version
```

## Motivation

Lets people evaluate the framework in 60 seconds without writing Python, and gives maintainers a quick smoke test. Depends on retriever persistence for `--index` to be meaningful; until then the CLI can run ingest + query in one invocation.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `ragframework/cli.py` with `main(argv=None)`; `[project.scripts] ragframework = "ragframework.cli:main"` in `pyproject.toml`
- [ ] Component selection by name with a small registry: `--loader {auto,text,markdown,pdf,directory}`, `--chunker {fixed,recursive,sentence}`, `--embedder {random,huggingface}`, `--retriever {memory,faiss,chroma}`, `--generator {echo}`; missing optional deps produce the standard install hint, exit code 1
- [ ] `--chunk-size`, `--chunk-overlap`, `--top-k` map onto `RAGConfig`
- [ ] `query` prints the answer, then sources as `[n] <id> (<source>)`; `--json` prints a machine-readable `RAGResponse`
- [ ] `--verbose` enables `logging` at INFO (see the logging issue)
- [ ] Tests invoke `main([...])` directly with `tmp_path` fixtures and the random/echo components; also `python -m ragframework` works (`__main__.py`)
- [ ] README "Quick Start" gets a CLI subsection; `CHANGELOG.md` updated

## Files to touch

- `ragframework/cli.py`, `ragframework/__main__.py` — new
- `pyproject.toml`
- `tests/test_cli.py` — new
